propositions: Review-bot uvicorn access logs record the full request line including query string, exposing the webhook_token secret in plaintext to journald on every /webhook and /rerun request
The webhook token defaults to GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN when WEBHOOK_TOKEN is unset, making the logged credential a Gerrit authentication vector readable by any journald consumer and log-grep operators
Token must be moved from query parameter to HTTP header (X-Rebar-Token) and a TokenRedactingFilter must scrub token values from access logs as a backstop to prevent credential exposure

The /rerun runbook recipe must no longer instruct operators to embed the token in the request URL, and must note that previously-logged tokens are compromised and must be rotated separately from this code fix
Access log must continue recording route and HTTP status for observability and debugging without logging the credential itself
